svg.title: Proposed: expression interfaces (RFC-88 section 4, refined)
svg.text: Engines translate into Hudi Expression once; catalogs and readers render out of it; one planner picks metadata-table indexes. Names are placeholders. Compare expression-today.svg.

g.text: String system(); // spark, flink, hive, trino
// conservative: push NOT to leaves, then drop an AND conjunct or a whole OR
// literals typed via TypeSystemMapper; strip a cast only if order-preserving
String target(); // hms, glue, parquet, spark-filter
// conservative: the rendered filter keeps every row the expression keeps
// HMS and Glue differ only in quoting: one renderer, two dialects
Predicates: AND, OR, NOT, EQ, GT, LT, IN, IS_NULL, STARTS_WITH, CONTAINS
Literal types: InternalSchema Types today, HoodieSchemaType next
also built by Hive sync's PartitionFilterGenerator (exists)
one evaluation for every engine; replaces
Spark's second Catalyst pass and the
CandidateFiles lookup(Expression filter, HoodieTableMetadata mdt, StatsEvaluator eval);
// option A: HudiStatsEvaluator in hudi-common (RFC-88's Evaluator over StructLike)
// option B: engine-native, e.g. SparkStatsEvaluator on DataFrames (vinothchandar)
// the open RFC-88 question becomes a pluggable choice, not a fork in the design
IndexLookup implementations, one per index type, same for every engine

svg.text: replace Spark's *IndexSupport classes, Flink's FileStatsIndex / RecordLevelIndex, Trino's Hudi*IndexSupport

g.text: option A: evaluates in hudi-common over
MDT stats read as StructLike; same
behind the interface; Flink and Trino

svg.text: Hive gets the same data skipping as Spark, Flink and Trino
Translators and renderers are conservative: never drop a row the original filter keeps.
Literal and column types come from TypeSystemMapper (HoodieSchemaType).
A cast is stripped only if it preserves order (the #19475 class); otherwise the predicate is dropped.
support() declares what each system can translate or render; unsupported shapes are dropped, not guessed.
Kit: the #20439 oracle per engine (pruned rows == unpruned rows), per translator and renderer.
Why: resolves the notes in expression-today.svg
Every engine enters through ExpressionTranslator, not just Spark partition pruning.
Index planning and translation are written once and oracle-tested; evaluation is pluggable.
IndexLookup implementations give every engine every index; Hive gains data skipping.
Literals typed by TypeSystemMapper: no LocalDate typed as a timestamp holding epoch days.
Partition filters evaluated once; the metastore gets a rendered filter, not raw Catalyst.
One renderer serves HMS and Glue, wired from the sync client.
